asked: The first world content pack (brief 330 W6): origins by ring, placeholder lines, kits, prices and arrivals per ring, prospecting maps and creature banners as drops, seeds where missing; every Live thing guaranteed in the inner ring of its tier in every world (owner, 2026-11-01); built nodes as fast as wild ones; the Starter Camp's first mine needs no map (T-284), with the held mines pack.

entries.note: The world tables, first content: every origin in the ring of its tier (tier-0 ones the Starter Camp holds repeated in ring 1); every creature camp guaranteed in the ring of its tier (11 in ring 1, 6 in ring 2); kits by biome; arrivals and prices per ring. Crops, Herbs, Waters and Arcane are placeholder lines: Herbs is Wild Lavender in every ring (so Alchemy can start in ring 1), Arcane borrows the Wishing Well and the Quartz Deposit until it has content of its own.
